other_failure_modes.name: In-sample Target Leakage
other_failure_modes.description: The agent performs target encoding and computes target-based aggregations (e.g., mean, min, max, std) directly on the training set without out-of-fold (OOF) techniques. This causes massive target leakage because the target of a given row is used to compute its own feature, leading to severe overfitting.

summary: The agent devises a sophisticated two-stage modeling approach to predict both the sign and magnitude of the trust fund disbursements. However, it introduces critical in-sample target leakage by calculating target encodings directly on the training data without out-of-fold splits, resulting in severe overfitting. Furthermore, it ignores the time-series nature of the financial records by using a random train/validation split rather than a temporal one.
